citation: Charitos EI et al., J Thorac Cardiovasc Surg 2012;144:72-80
clinical_question: Mathematical definition of temporal AF density and clustering
findings: Temporal clustering predicts post-ablation AF recurrence independently of cumulative burden.
relevance_to_project: Core mathematical definition of AF density used across all V1-V5 pipelines.

citation: Rosman L et al., J Am Coll Cardiol 2026;87:412-423
clinical_question: Independent association between AF density and thromboembolic stroke risk
findings: High density carries 1.34x adjusted stroke HR; low burden high density has 1.28x HR.
limitations: Device AHRE counter; daily aggregated durations; 98% male VA population.
relevance_to_project: Benchmark paper replicated in R01-R05; highlights the 74 Low-Burden/High-Density patient phenotype.

citation: Rosman L et al. (Correction), J Am Coll Cardiol 2026;87:1205
clinical_question: Erratum on denominator reporting and baseline covariate adjustments
findings: Corrected person-month denominators across density categories; stroke association preserved.
relevance_to_project: Mandated correction of our earlier R01 comparator from 36.5% to 54.9% High density.

citation: Daghlas I, Marcus GM, J Am Coll Cardiol 2026;87:424-426
clinical_question: Editorial commentary on biological mechanisms of AF density (atrial cardiomyopathy)
findings: Hypothesized that high density reflects acute reversible electrical triggering, whereas low density reflects diffuse substrate.
limitations: Conceptual framework without direct histological or echocardiographic validation.
relevance_to_project: Direct motivation for SHDB structural association (LAD vs density).

citation: Noriega J et al., IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2026;73:641-652
clinical_question: P-wave morphological variability (PMV) in pre-AF prediction
findings: Reported progressive exponential increase in PMV during 60 minutes preceding AF onset.
limitations: Small cohort; potential label leakage; lack of leak-free landmarking.
relevance_to_project: Target of our dedicated PMV replication and shift toward post-AF atrial stunning.

citation: Spitaler PA et al., Heart Rhythm 2026;23:S1547-5271
clinical_question: Early AF episode entrenchment and duration-dependent termination hazard
findings: Termination hazard collapses monotonically with elapsed duration ('AF begets AF').
limitations: Did not separate within-episode electrophysiology from between-patient frailty.
relevance_to_project: Directly resolved in our E01-E03 shared Gamma frailty modeling across 8,540 episodes.

clinical_question: Ventricular Cycle-to-Cycle (VCC) variation in early AF termination prediction
findings: Higher VCC independently predicted spontaneous AF termination within 1 hour.
limitations: Small inpatient sample; no noise stress or ectopy challenge.
relevance_to_project: Evaluated in E04 and Noise Holter; proved VCC is non-significant after clustering and collapses under noise.

citation: Petrutiu S et al., IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2006;53:2241-2251
clinical_question: Atrial fibrillatory rate (AFR) extraction via adaptive spatiotemporal QRST cancellation
cohort: Surface ECG during persistent and paroxysmal AF
findings: Adaptive template cancellation achieved >10 dB ventricular suppression and recovered true atrial rates.
limitations: Requires precise QRS alignment; sensitive to axis shifts.
relevance_to_project: Technical basis for AFR pilot and 3-cohort authentic validation.

clinical_question: Open-access multi-day ambulatory Holter database in AF
findings: Provided prolonged continuous ambulatory records capturing persistent and paroxysmal AF dynamics.
relevance_to_project: Primary continuous cohort for sustained AF and multi-day stability analyses.

clinical_question: Clinical Holter database with verified echocardiography
findings: Registry linking ambulatory Holter waveforms with structural cardiac remodeling.
limitations: 30 records unannotated; variable echo-to-Holter temporal gap.
relevance_to_project: Only cohort with echocardiographic metadata; basis for structural association adjudication.
